verdict.rationale: EBANX's docs describe an API Reference that lets you fill or pre-fill card and payment fields and send the request directly from the reference. Ready-to-use sandbox card objects with expected responses act as runnable examples, so the core interactive try-it capability is first-party. That evidence comes from a single test-cards page, however, and the probe found no public OpenAPI spec. Coverage across the whole API reference is therefore unproven. missing for 10: evidence that runnable try-it requests cover the full API reference beyond card and payment fields, documentation of how the interactive console works (auth, environments, code generation), a public machine-readable spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
